douyinAssets.title: Douyin Content Assets
douyinAssets.loadFailedFallback: Please retry; check host logs if it keeps failing

library.deleteDescription: {{count}} captured record(s) will be soft-deleted (data stays in the host and can be purged later).
library.empty: No entries yet. Open a Douyin page with Bench Companion and click "Read visible entries" to start capturing.

capture.step1: Open your Douyin favorites / likes / posts list page in the browser.
capture.step2: Click the Bench Companion icon in the browser toolbar.
capture.step3: Pick a list type under "Douyin capture" and click "Read visible entries".
capture.step4: Review the previewed entries, then click "Submit to Bench" to confirm.
capture.step5: Scroll to the next screen and read again to keep capturing; refresh this library afterwards.
capture.boundaryNote: Boundary: only entries visible on the current page are read. No cookies, no network interception, no auto-scrolling, and no like/favorite/follow/comment actions.
capture.mediaWorker: Media worker (ASR / OCR, arrives with DCA-02)
capture.limitsLine: Batch limit {{maxBatchItems}} entries; single-file import limit {{maxImportFileBytes}}.
